in_greek.name: Βελδα
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name Belda is derived from the Greek word βελτις, meaning ‘excellent’ or ‘best’. The name Belda in Greek suggests a woman of exceptional qualities and great strength.

in_latin.name: Belda
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name Belda is derived from the Latin word belle, meaning ‘beautiful’ or ‘lovely’. However, it is also associated with the Latin word robustus, meaning ‘strong’ or ‘powerful’. The name Belda in Latin suggests a woman who is not only beautiful but also strong and powerful.
